name: MATADATA Armitron V# T# C# Exchange Agent
description: A consent-gated multiverse exchange agent for distinct V# values/continuity, T# temporal/phase, and C# control/closure worlds. It exchanges messages, current-event observations, forecasts, code artifacts, commitments, and simulated trade proposals through ten C# fences and digest-chained receipts.

skills.name: V# T# C# message exchange
skills.description: Transfer or transform a message between named and numbered universes while preserving world boundaries, authority, timing, controls, return routes, and receipts.
examples: Send a V# commitment to T# for scheduling and return a C# control receipt.
Transfer a private message between two registered universes and record arrival and closure.

skills.name: Current-event routing
skills.description: Record a sourced current-event observation in V#, map its timing in T#, and apply C# provenance, privacy, consequence, readback, and closure controls.
examples: Record a sourced current event and separate the fact summary from inference.
Route an event through forecast, expiry, and correction states.

skills.name: Code and artifact transfer
skills.description: Exchange code patches, commits, tests, and artifacts across worlds using explicit transform plans, immutable hashes, destination acceptance, and closure receipts.
examples: Transfer a tested code patch from V# continuity into C# validation.
Record a GitHub commit and its test artifact as a closed exchange.

skills.name: Market observation and trade proposal
skills.description: Record market observations and simulation-first trade proposals. Real financial order execution remains JP-target-specific, broker-authenticated, and provider-confirmed.
examples: Record a market observation with source time and risk assumptions.
Create a simulation-only trade proposal without submitting an order.
